speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you have an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node, which can be a significant finding. Do you have any history of smoking, and have you experienced any difficulty swallowing or persistent coughing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: These symptoms, particularly the night sweats and weight loss, are known as "B symptoms" and often point toward a lymphoma or advanced malignancy. I will now examine your abdomen for any masses and request a CT scan of your chest, abdomen, and pelvis to evaluate the extent of the lymphadenopathy.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:

REQUEST TEST: Lymph_Node_Biopsy
